svg.title: Four moments from a Product page loading comparison
svg.desc: At 0, 2, 6, and 10 seconds after navigation, the same Mobile diagnostic capture shows Inertia and React on Rails Pro side by side. This is not an aggregate result.
svg.text: Profile layout · Mobile · empty cache · one diagnostic load
First paint in this capture: Inertia 9.46 s · React on Rails Pro 1.14 s
The filmstrip is one load, not the median of 20 measurements per side.
